cards.ex: The ambassador tried to leverage his influence to secure the prisoner's release.
cards.exUz: Elchi mahbusni ozod qilishni ta'minlash uchun o'z ta'siridan foydalanishga harakat qildi.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsaga erishish uchun ta'sir kuchini ishlatish.

cards.ex: Sometimes quiet diplomacy is more effective than public pronouncements.
cards.exUz: Ba'zan yashirin diplomatiya ommaviy bayonotlardan ko'ra samaraliroq bo'ladi.
cards.uzDef: Ommaga oshkor qilmasdan muzokaralar olib borish.

cards.ex: The border demarcation remains a significant point of contention between the two countries.
cards.exUz: Chegara demarkatsiyasi ikki davlat o'rtasidagi muhim bahsli nuqta bo'lib qolmoqda.

cards.ex: The mediator stepped in to defuse the tension between the parties.
cards.exUz: Vositchi tomonlar o'rtasidagi keskinlikni yumshatish uchun aralashdi.

cards.ex: Their negotiating stance seems inflexible, making progress difficult.
cards.exUz: Ularning muzokara pozitsiyasi moslashuvchan emasdek ko'rinadi, bu esa taraqqiyotni qiyinlashtiradi.

cards.ex: The diplomat invoked diplomatic immunity to avoid prosecution.
cards.exUz: Diplomat ta'qibdan qochish uchun diplomatik daxlsizlik huquqini ishga soldi.

cards.ex: The government is walking a tightrope, trying to balance economic growth with environmental protection.
cards.exUz: Hukumat iqtisodiy o'sishni atrof-muhitni muhofaza qilish bilan muvozanatlashga harakat qilib, xavfli vaziyatda turibdi.
cards.uzDef: Qiyin vaziyatda muvozanatni saqlashga harakat qilish.

cards.ex: We need to bridge the gap between our cultures to achieve understanding.
cards.exUz: Tushunishga erishish uchun madaniyatlarimiz o'rtasidagi farqni bartaraf etishimiz kerak.

cards.ex: Diplomacy is essentially the art of compromise.
cards.exUz: Diplomatiya, asosan, kelishuv san'atidir.

cards.ex: They used back-channel communication to resolve the crisis before it escalated.
cards.exUz: Ular inqiroz kuchayishidan oldin uni hal qilish uchun yopiq aloqa kanalidan foydalanishdi.

cards.ex: The senator decided to table a motion for a vote on the new bill.
cards.exUz: Senator yangi qonun loyihasi bo'yicha ovoz berish uchun taklif kiritishga qaror qildi.

cards.ex: The president made a diplomatic overture to the opposing nation.
cards.exUz: Prezident qarama-qarshi davlatga diplomatik tashabbus bilan chiqdi.

cards.ex: Both sides agreed to de-escalate the situation to prevent further conflict.
cards.exUz: Ikkala tomon ham kelishmovchilikning oldini olish uchun vaziyatni yumshatishga kelishib oldi.

cards.ex: We need to define the terms of engagement before we can begin collaborating.
cards.exUz: Hamkorlikni boshlashimizdan oldin, hamkorlik shartlarini belgilashimiz kerak.

cards.ex: Maintaining a delicate balance between national security and individual freedom is essential.
cards.exUz: Milliy xavfsizlik va shaxsiy erkinlik o'rtasida nozik muvozanatni saqlash juda muhim.

cards.ex: I was tempted to renegotiate, but decided to leave well enough alone.
cards.exUz: Men qayta muzokara qilishga vasvasaga tushdim, lekin yaxshisini buzmaslikka qaror qildim.
cards.uzDef: Agar hamma narsa yaxshi bo'lsa, o'zgartirishga urinmaslik.

cards.ex: The peace talks are on a knife-edge; one wrong move could ruin everything.
cards.exUz: Tinchlik muzokaralari xavfli vaziyatda; bitta noto'g'ri harakat hamma narsani buzishi mumkin.

cards.ex: The committee worked for hours to reach a consensus on the budget.
cards.exUz: Qo'mita byudjet bo'yicha kelishuvga erishish uchun soatlab ishladi.
cards.uzDef: Hamma a'zolar tomonidan qabul qilingan qarorga kelish.

cards.ex: When neither side was willing to compromise, a stalemate ensued.
cards.exUz: Hech bir tomon kelishuvga tayyor bo'lmaganida, to'xtab qolish holati yuzaga keldi.
cards.uzDef: Hech qanday taraqqiyot bo'lmagan vaziyat yuzaga keladi.

cards.ex: In a crisis, it's important to exercise restraint and avoid rash decisions.
cards.exUz: Inqirozda o'zini tutish va shoshilinch qarorlardan qochish muhimdir.

cards.ex: The aim is to open channels for dialogue and find a peaceful solution.
cards.exUz: Maqsad - muloqot uchun kanallarni ochish va tinch yo'l bilan yechim topish.

cards.ex: The ceasefire agreement has established a fragile peace in the region.
cards.exUz: O't ochishni to'xtatish to'g'risidagi bitim mintaqada mo'rt tinchlikni o'rnatdi.
cards.uzDef: Osonlik bilan buzilishi mumkin bo'lgan tinchlik.

cards.ex: Both leaders need to tone down their rhetoric to create a more positive atmosphere for negotiations.
cards.exUz: Muzokaralar uchun ijobiy muhit yaratish uchun har ikki rahbar o'z nutqlarini yumshatishlari kerak.

cards.ex: The company offered the striking workers an olive branch by increasing wages.
cards.exUz: Kompaniya ish tashlayotgan ishchilarga ish haqini oshirish orqali tinchlik taklifini bildirdi.

cards.ex: Negotiations shouldn't be a zero-sum game; both sides should benefit.
cards.exUz: Muzokaralar nol natijali o'yin bo'lmasligi kerak; har ikki tomon ham foyda ko'rishi kerak.

cards.ex: The negotiator was known for pushing the envelope to get the best possible deal.
cards.exUz: Muzokarachisi eng yaxshi kelishuvga erishish uchun chegarani kengaytirishi bilan tanilgan edi.

cards.ex: We tried to leverage common ground on environmental issues to foster cooperation.
cards.exUz: Hamkorlikni rivojlantirish uchun atrof-muhit masalalari bo'yicha umumiy asosdan foydalanishga harakat qildik.
cards.uzDef: Kelishuvga erishish uchun umumiy fikrlardan foydalanish.

cards.ex: The international community needs to throw a lifeline to the struggling nation.
cards.exUz: Xalqaro hamjamiyat kurashayotgan davlatga yordam qo'lini cho'zishi kerak.

cards.ex: They reached an agreement at the eleventh hour, averting a strike.
cards.exUz: Ular ish tashlashning oldini olib, so'nggi daqiqada kelishuvga erishdilar.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsa qilish uchun eng so'nggi imkoniyatda.

cards.ex: The news spread quickly through diplomatic circles.
cards.exUz: Bu xabar diplomatik doiralarda tez tarqaldi.
